verdict.rationale: Bento's docs explicitly describe a dedicated transactional email feature for one-to-one messages like password resets, receipts, login codes, and order confirmations, sent via the same platform used for marketing, and note dedicated IP options for high-volume senders. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation this uses the same unified API endpoint as marketing sends, and independent/hands-on corroboration of transactional delivery in practice.
